description: Template for the first cycle of the ClearGlassInc revenue validation plan. Not loaded or run automatically. The operator creates it through the authenticated API or CLI after approving the plan and deciding the four items in clearglassinc-plan-first.approvals.json.

mission.title: Market Validation Brief for the smart-glass maintenance and retrofit offer
mission.objective: Produce the Market Validation Brief the plan names as its first deliverable, so the decision owner can choose a primary segment on evidence.
deliverables: Competitor map with pricing and positioning evidence
Kill criteria and human approval requirements
constraints: Plan-first mode: research, analysis and drafts only
No email, no publishing, no CRM writes, no spending
No claims of energy savings, ROI or performance without substantiation
approval_rules: Any outreach, publication, CRM write or spend needs a separate production mission and operator approval of the exact payload

params.title: Segment ranking with evidence quality
params.purpose: Rank the three candidate segments by the evidence available for each, not by preference.
required_content: Facilities managers and real-estate operations leaders
Commercial property owners and asset managers
Luxury residential developers and premium property managers
For each: budget authority, problem recognition, path to a paid pilot, evidence quality
Ranking method and what would change the ranking
evidence_rules: Every market claim is tagged VERIFIED, INFERENCE or ASSUMPTION
A VERIFIED claim cites at least two independent sources from the source register
No figure is stated without its source, date and the population it describes
Unknowns are written as UNKNOWN or NOT ESTABLISHED, never estimated
not_permitted_in_this_cycle: Contacting any prospect, customer or third party
Claiming energy savings, ROI or performance
params.status_note: Outline only. Findings are added after the operator approves the research sources.
